commentary: Revenue for August came in at [[revenue.month.actual]], above budget by [[revenue.month.vs_budget]] ([[revenue.month.vs_budget_pct]]) and up on last year by [[revenue.month.vs_py]] ([[revenue.month.vs_py_pct]]), but direct costs of [[direct_costs.month.actual]] ran higher than budget by [[direct_costs.month.vs_budget]] ([[direct_costs.month.vs_budget_pct]]), leaving gross margin at [[gross_margin.month.actual]], below budget by [[gross_margin.month.vs_budget_pp]] and down on last year by [[gross_margin.month.vs_py_pp]]. Operating profit for August was [[operating_profit.month.actual]], below budget by [[operating_profit.month.vs_budget]] ([[operating_profit.month.vs_budget_pct]]) and down on last year by [[operating_profit.month.vs_py]] ([[operating_profit.month.vs_py_pct]]). Year to date, the picture is stronger: revenue of [[revenue.ytd.actual]] is above budget by [[revenue.ytd.vs_budget]] ([[revenue.ytd.vs_budget_pct]]) and up on last year by [[revenue.ytd.vs_py]] ([[revenue.ytd.vs_py_pct]]), while operating profit of [[operating_profit.ytd.actual]] is above budget by [[operating_profit.ytd.vs_budget]] ([[operating_profit.ytd.vs_budget_pct]]) and up on last year by [[operating_profit.ytd.vs_py]] ([[operating_profit.ytd.vs_py_pct]]). On clients, Orchard Lane Foods remains the largest account, with August revenue of [[client.orchard-lane.revenue.month.actual]] (31% of agency revenue) up on its May to July average by [[client.orchard-lane.revenue.month.vs_avg3m]] ([[client.orchard-lane.revenue.month.vs_avg3m_pct]]), and Kestrel Mobility's August revenue of [[client.kestrel.revenue.month.actual]] was also up on its May to July average by [[client.kestrel.revenue.month.vs_avg3m]] ([[client.kestrel.revenue.month.vs_avg3m_pct]]). Marlow & Finch's August revenue of [[client.marlow-finch.revenue.month.actual]] was down on its May to July average by [[client.marlow-finch.revenue.month.vs_avg3m]] ([[client.marlow-finch.revenue.month.vs_avg3m_pct]]), which the owner may wish to review.
